notes.title: Game Update! (v0.4.6)
notes.content:
[img src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/1ySNNkOse5tFWtaeSluG4EK0zqAVV_l3S"]


New Update!


FINALLY the achievements are out!



This patch was a ton of work, and I’m so happy it's finally done! Getting the achievement system finished feels like a huge step toward 1.0. Right now the game has 85 achievements. Aside from the ones you unlock just by progressing, I also added some that take a little creative thinking to figure out, plus a few ideas that came from players during Early Access. My goal with achievements is more about "encouraging players to do some weird stuff" rather than making them insanely hard (the most difficult one is likely the Infernal Shard 24 achievement). Kinda like extra challenges layered on top of the game.



Also, there are a few new towers added in this update! I used to be very cautious about towers that move enemies. Since maze-building is the core of the game, mechanics like that can easily break the balance. This time I'm trying something new: alongside adding those towers, I also added a build limit system to keep things fair. Let me know how it feels once you've tried them, and I'll be adjusting based on feedback!



As for the next update, I think it's going to be a regular content patch (need a little rest after working on this patch...). As always, there will be new content, and I'll also go back to polish and tweak some existing systems, as well as address some of the things suggested in the feedback.



That's all. Hope you all have a great time achievement hunting! 🏆



- Refi


[hr][/hr]

New Features

Achievements System
Added 85 achievements!

2 of them are tied to unreleased characters and cannot be unlocked yet. The other 83 are unlockable.

About 30% are progress-type achievements. The one you've already met the requirements will auto-unlock when you launch the game.

The rest are mostly challenge-type achievements, including higher-difficulty challenges and tasks that need special approaches.

The Compendium now has an Achievements page. The Tower and Relic pages will also show relics you have used.


New Towers
Blackhole Tower (3x3+): Fires a mini black hole that pulls in monsters within its range.

Barrage Tower (1x5): Rapidly bombards a distant area.

Portal Tower (1x3): Teleports passing monsters back to where they were a few seconds ago.

Chainball Tower (1x2): Launches a massive chainball that knocks back enemies straight ahead and stuns them.

Golden Statue (Rework): Turns monsters into gold; attacking gilded enemies makes them drop extra coins.

A few of these new towers are especially powerful. To keep things balanced (otherwise you can win every game with a full line of portals), these towers have a build limit. Blackhole Tower, Portal Tower, and Golden Statue are limited to one on the field at a time.






Game Adjustments

Towers
Scrap Tower: The tower info panel now shows remaining ammo.

Golden Statue: The tower info panel now shows total coins earned.
Relics
Chaos Transmuter: Now only affects 1x1, 2x2, and 3x3 towers.
Other
Treasure chests that are obscured will now display a yellow outline and a see-through tint.

Leaderboard now clearly shows which character's leaderboard you're viewing.

The anomaly "At the start of each round, several 1x1 Lava tiles will fall from the sky." is removed from daily/weekly challenges.

Added more tower–relic combinations for daily/weekly challenges.






Balance Changes
Drill Tower: Removed from Endless Mode temporarily.

Well...I thought using the red upgrade to juggle the monsters was too exhausting and not worth it just to climb the leaderboard.... But I was wrong, I saw someone spend 8 HOURS doing that to get to the top of the leaderboard. I really respect that dedication, but it isn't a good thing for either the people doing it or those who choose not to.

So, for everyone's health, I'm removing it from Endless Mode for now and will bring it back after some adjustments!

Fireball Tower: Fire rate increased by 20%.

Magic Arrow Tower: Damage +20%.

Froststorm Tower: Build cost +15.

Thunder Tower: Build cost +15.

Starfall Tower: Build cost +15.

There's some feedback that 3x3 towers feel too powerful, but I think having strong damage output feels better for the 3x3s, so I'll try to increase cost adjustments about 10–15% first.

Crusher Bot: 

Self-stun on wall impact increased from 3s → 5s.

The rate of rolling speed increase was reduced by 50%.

Crusher Bot is one of the few enemies that needs special maze layouts to deal with. These changes make its weakness stand out more.





[hr][/hr]

Post-Patch Fixes
Fixed an issue where towers built before the game started were not sealed by the Ancient Flame.,

Fixed the bug where the Giant Dice Tower did not unlock the achievement after a reroll.,

Fixed the problem where the Barrage Tower's attack range did not update after removing the distance buff.,

Fixed an issue where the "Block Mesa" achievement incorrectly counted removed blocks when using the Joker.,

Changed the requirement for the "Elementalist" achievement: it is now "Complete a game on Normal difficulty or higher with only one element of towers (Fire, Ice, Electric, Poison, or Arcane) on the field for the entire run, and defeat the final boss."

When the anomaly "When medium or larger monsters die, they spawn three skeletons" is active, destroying an Ancient Defense Tower will no longer spawn skeletons.

Fixed an issue where the Starfall Tower could not attack Ancient Defense Towers that are positioned higher.

Utility tower will now display their elements in the tooltip.

notes.title: Game Update! (v0.4.5)
notes.content:
[img src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/1WxiuDl5h3LrUmo43GOdQZHtCX5JKg5DJ"]


New Update!


This patch adds Daily and Weekly Challenges to Endless Mode!



Recently, I've been thinking a lot about what the "final form" of Emberward should look like. I've played a ton of fun tower defense games in the past. They were super fun, but once I finished them, I often didn't feel like going back. I always wished there was something that kept pulling me back in with new challenges. That's the idea behind the new Daily and Weekly Challenges in this update!



These challenges use maps from the regular roguelite mode, but with added twists and modifiers. Sometimes you'll get a ton of relics to play with, sometimes the elements are limited, or you might be handed a specific tower/relic combo and have to figure out how to make it work. The goal is to give you something new and interesting every time you launch the game! I'll keep tweaking this mode based on your feedback (maybe even a version with Inferno Shards?), so let me know what you think after giving it a try!



For the next update, I'm planning to focus on the Achievement System (finally!). It's going to be a pretty big feature, not just coding-wise, but also building the UI, making tons of icons, and doing a lot of testing. I'm guessing it'll probably take over a month to finish, so if there's no update by late August or early September, don't worry! I'll release it as soon as it's ready.



That's it for now. Hope you enjoy the new endless modes!



- Refi


[hr][/hr]

New Features

Roguelite mode:
12 new maps have been added to the game!

Academy:

The Academy now has a reroll system.

Limited Rerolls Initially: Before you have cleared all four regions (on any difficulty), you need to spend points to reroll.

Clearing each level restores 1 reroll point, and clearing a boss level restores 5 points. You can store up to 20 reroll points.

Unlimited After Full Clear: Once you've cleared all four regions on any difficulty, rerolls become unlimited.

This issue…to be honest, it's been bothering me for a long time. For most players (especially new players) I think it's better to encourage trying new combinations. But at higher difficulties, having to constantly restart the game to find a suitable combo gets really annoying. After testing a few versions, I feel this solution is the most balanced approach. It fixes the reroll problem in high difficulty without making new players feel like they must always roll the perfect set before they can start playing.


Endless Mode:
Added Daily and Weekly Challenges to Endless Mode. These challenges have different special conditions and anomaly effects to mix up the gameplay.

Starting Block Selection: You can now choose the blocks for your deck at the start of Endless Mode.

Added a Quick Restart option in the pause menu for faster retries.

Unlock Requirement Change: Because the new mode uses maps from all four regions, the unlock requirement for Endless Mode has been changed. you now unlock Endless Mode after clearing all four regions on any difficulty.




Game Adjustments

Difficulty
Failing a level in Casual difficulty will no longer end your run.

Normal & Heroic stays the same.

I noticed from recent feedback that for some players, even Casual mode felt stressful in the later regions. So...since it's called Casual mode, I think it's fine if it doesn't strictly follow the roguelite rules. This way, players who just want a relaxing, low-pressure experience can enjoy the game, and those still learning won't be so afraid of failure that they stop trying new tactics.


Settings
Mute In Background Option: Added an option to mute audio when the game is running in the background.

Progress Reset: Added a function to reset your game progress (use with caution!).

Stealth Mode: Added a Stealth Mode option to help you play sneakily [strike]at work[/strike] with a lower chance of being noticed. (It looks like THIS)


Treasure Chests
Treasure chests now have a very low chance to contain a Gambler's Token.


Compendium
Added category tabs on the Tower page. You can now filter towers by their element or by tower size.


Characters
Chunk

Unlock requirement changed from building 2x2 towers to building any tower larger than 1x1.
Quests
The quest "Keep enemies at least X tiles away from the Fire Source" now uses a square area for its range check (instead of a circular radius).

Relics
Impact Dispersion System: Effect changed to "When a tower receives a malfunction effect from monsters, the effect is halved. If the remaining malfunction duration exceeds 2 seconds, it is evenly distributed to other functioning towers within 3 tiles."


[hr][/hr]

Post-Patch Fixes
Adjusted the modifiers for daily/weekly missions.

Fixed an issue where the dice tower could not be rerolled.

Made adjustments/fixes to some maps.

notes.title: Game Update! (v0.4.4)
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44393347/75f96ccd737c81153e0087fe10613ac110a87eb3.png"]

Surprise Update!!


Not sure if anyone noticed, but today marks the one-year anniversary of Emberward's Early Access!

(I was so naive to think I could finish the game in one year...Emberward is now at least three times bigger than I originally planned.)



This past year has been insanely busy and exhausting, but also a lot of fun! I've had the chance to meet players from all over the world, learned a ton of things I never expected to deal with, and…released a bunch of bugs. Honestly, I wouldn't have made it this far without everyone's support. Thank you all for playing the game, allowing me to work on it full-time!



Also, a huge thank you to all the players, Youtubers, and streamers who helped spread the word about the game! There's no way I could've reached so many people on my own (and please continue to recommend the game to your friends! I really need the help 😭). And I really appreciate everyone who gave feedback on Discord, by email, through surveys, or even joined the playtests. Your feedback was incredibly helpful in helping me improve the game!



Anyway, thank you all for your support and help throughout the year! This update was made as a special thank you, and...it's probably the weirdest patch you've ever seen in Emberward.

(I know a lot of you have been trying so hard to clear Infernal Shards 24 that your blood pressure is through the roof. Hopefully this update will help you relax a little!)



Hope you enjoy the update, have fun!



- Refi


[hr][/hr]

New Feature

New Character: Scrap Master (Anniversary Special Event Character)
Once a legendary inventor at the Academy, she left to wander the world in search of inspiration.

Unlock by clearing Sealed Citadel on any difficulty.

Like the Joker, Scrapmaster is also a special event character. Once the achievement system is in the game, harder achievements will not be obtainable using special event characters.



(By the way, some players asked during the last April Fools' event why event characters need to be unlocked, instead of being available to everyone right away. It's mainly because event characters are all about adding fun, maybe even a little silly ideas into the game, which makes their balance and playstyles different from regular characters. If they were available from the start, many new players' first run would be using an event character, which would make their experience very strange. So that's why these characters only unlock after clearing all the regions on any difficulty!)

notes.title: Game Update! (v0.4.3)
notes.content:
[img src="https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbzd0bjY4bGQ5dGdkMW0xZDU3eDY3NTVrc2JtNXNtcnNvb2VwdnFkNyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/P8bBYGT4VJbg0vEIku/giphy.gif"]


New Update!


I thought this update would be easier to make, but it turned out to be a tough one!



Designing the tier 3 Infernal Shards fried a lot of my brain cells, but I'm pretty happy with the result. I tried to come up with a system that isn't too harsh, but still provides an extra challenge. If you're into tough challenges, give it a try and let me know what you think! (Shard level 24 is...really hard)



Also, some new Poison towers were added in this update, so now the five elements each have about the same number of towers. As for the Poison-element relics, since they were created early in development, I plan to adjust their effects in the future to better fit the current state of the game.

(I guess some of you are going to ask, so I'll answer now: yes, there will be more towers added in the future!)



After this update, I'll be spending more time on other features like Endless Mode, the achievement system, and a few experimental ideas I'm playing with. I also spent some extra time adding character selection to Misty Graveyard and reworking the leaderboard in this patch to prepare for a new Endless Mode map. (The most annoying thing was dealing with cheaters... if nobody cheated, I could've used that week to make more new towers instead!) I know a lot of you have been waiting for Endless Mode for a long time, and I hope to show you the new stuff soon!



That's it. Hope you all enjoy this update! 



- Refi


[hr][/hr]New Features
Infernal Shards: Level 3 Infernal Shards are now unlocked, allowing you to face the most difficult challenges!

Towers: Added three new Poison towers:

Slime Tower (1x1) – Fires slimes that continuously bounces forward.

Mushroom Tower (2x2) – Throws mushrooms that stick to monsters and continuously emit toxic spores.

Cauldron Tower (3x3) – Absorbs nearby defeated monsters to increase the toxicity in the cauldron!

Flames: Candle Flame – Ability reworked. 
(Originally, Candle Flame was an option for players who wanted a 1 HP challenge. Now that the 1 HP restriction is built into the level 3 Infernal Shard, Candle Flame has been given a new ability.)

Endless Mode: 

Misty Graveyard now has character selection, allowing you to play with any unlocked character (not including special event characters).

Each character has its own leaderboard. 

The leaderboards have been reset due to a data format change, and the new version will also display the player’s relics on the leaderboard.


Game Adjustments
Towers: 

Chomp Tower is now a Poison tower.

Blocks: 

Added more variations of blocks distorted by anomaly effects.

Talents: 

Loot Scavenging no longer counts gold gained from selling towers.

Boss Battles:

Forest: On difficulties where no Infernal Shard is active, the boss will now also spit fireballs and breathe fire. However, the malfunction duration caused by these attacks is only half as long as it is with an Infernal Shard active, and the attack will not turn blocks into lava blocks.

Maps:

The Scrap Tower will no longer appear as an option in the Academy stage’s tower selection.

Anomaly stages now display an icon indicating the anomaly’s effect.

Added 7 new anomaly effects.

Menu:

Hovering over "Continue" now displays the difficulty and character of the current game in progress.



Balance Changes
Towers:

Drone Tower: Attack speed increased from 2 to 2.5.

Basic Tower: Range increased from 4 to 6.

Cannon Tower: Attack damage increase from 5 to  6

Laser Tower: Attack speed increased from 1.6 to 2.

Decimate Tower: Attack speed increased from 0.25 to 0.3.

Frost Ray Tower: The Blue upgrade’s explosion effect damage multiplier reduced from 3× to 2×.

Starfall Tower: 

Meteors' explosion radius reduced from 1.5 to 1. 

The red upgrade's explosion radius reduced from 3.5 to 2.5. 

Relics:

Static Shocker now has a damage cap of 1000.

Unstable Mixture now has a damage cap of 1500.

 (Relics that deal percentage-based damage were too strong in Endless Mode, causing the mid-to-late game difficulty curve to ramp up too quickly. Damage caps were added to ensure they don't become the only viable solution in Endless Mode.)

notes.title: Game Update! (v0.4.2)
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/pnKz9Cc.gif

New Update!

This update introduces the highest difficulty system in the game - Infernal Shards. Since I need lots of feedback to figure out what's the expected difficulty for hardcore players, please let me know what you think after trying it out! The first two tiers are available in this patch, and the third tier will be available in the next patch. 

Originally, I planned to add more poison towers in this patch, but working on the Infernal Shard system took up most of my time, so the new towers will be postponed to a later update. Instead, I used the spare time to make several new relics. Some of them are quite different from the previous ones!

As for the April Fools Event character - Joker (honestly, I was surprised so many people liked it!), it will remain in the game and will be labeled as an "Event Character". Since the fun of this character lies in its chaotic nature and block-removal mechanic, balancing it to match the strength of other characters would likely turn it into a really boring character. So, the plan is to keep it usable in most of the game modes, but after the Achievement System is implemented, using the Joker in high-difficulty content (like the newly added Infernal Shards) will not unlock achievements. This allows me to add some silly event ideas to the game without worrying about overall balance!

Hope you all have fun trying out the new challenges! 


- Refi

[hr][/hr]
New Feature: Infernal Shards
Originally this was only planned for Heroic difficulty, but I know some players prefer a more relaxed experience, or don't have enough time to play high-difficulty content, so in the end I decided to release this system in all three difficulty levels. I hope everyone can play at the difficulty they're comfortable with and still experience the upgraded boss fights and new challenges!


Unlocked after clearing the Sealed Citadel. 
Activate Infernal Shards to add more challenge to your run.
There are 8 different types of shards, each representing a different category of challenge. Each type has 3 difficulty tiers.
Monsters and bosses become stronger as you activate more shards.
Tier 1 and 2 shards are available in this update. Tier 3 is coming in the next one.


15 New Relics Added: 

Wood Elf's Charm: When you play the leftmost card in your hand, all your towers cost 3 gold less to build. Restores after building any tower. If a block card triggers this effect, the block it places will be locked immediately.
Dormant Hammer: If you do not build a certain type of tower in a round, its cost is reduced by 15%. Stacks up to 5 times. Cost resets after building the tower.
Statue of Greed: When a monster dies within 5 tiles of your fire source, you gain 30% to 100% extra gold. The closer it dies, the more gold you gain.
Bomber's Package: If the leftmost card in your hand is a block card with an empty rune slot, it automatically gains an Explosion Rune. Can trigger up to 3 times per turn.
Impact Dispersion System: When a tower receives malfunction effect from monsters, the duration is evenly shared with nearby towers within 3 tiles. Each affected tower will be disabled for at least 1 second.
Statue of Poverty: When you have less than 30 gold, each missing gold increases the critical rate of all towers by 1%.
Cartographer's Manual: For every 5 blocks locked, you earn one free card draw.
Auctioneer's Cheat Sheet: In preparation phase, towers on buff tiles can be sold at full price, and does not lose value over time.
Waste Recovery System: Building a tower that costs more than 15/45/75 gold will create 1/2/3 Scrap Towers within 5x5 area. The tower's sell price is reduced by 5/10/15 gold.
Chameleon Shell: When a Normal type tower is placed next to a tower with other elements, it changes to that element. If there are multiple elements nearby, one is chosen at random.
Amulet of Light: At the end of each turn, removes the 5 corrupted tiles closest to the fire source. One of the removed tiles turns into an Attack Boost Tile.
Glacial Axe: Each stack of Chill increases the chance for monsters to receive a critical hit by 5%.
Amplify Matrix: When a tower crits, towers within 3 tiles gain 20% critical rate for 5 seconds. This effect does not stack.
Venom Satchel: When you use the rightmost card in your hand, a random tower without a buff card effect gains the "Poison Bottle" enhancement. If a block card triggers this effect, the block it places will be locked immediately.
Magma Gem: Burn duration is increased by 100%, but Burn consumes 1 stack of Chill every second.


Game Adjustments
Boss fights

 Steelrail Overlord (Bone Desert):

 After pushing back the boss, the layout of the new train is no longer a fixed combination.

 Skeleton King (Frost Ruins):

 The wind mechanic has been removed.
 New mechanic added: Trial of the Skeleton King.
 Every three turns, the Skeleton King will present a choice. You must select one out of five trial challenges. Each option can only be selected once.

Game Options

 Added an option to reduce the electrical conductivity effect of blocks. When enabled, it switches to a less flashy visual effect.


Balance Adjustments:
Characters

 Tana the Sorcerer: Extra tower build cost decreased to 30%, but now also affects upgrade cost.
This makes it easier for Tana to survive the early game, and makes her less powerful in the later waves.

Monsters

 Broodmother: Base HP - 10%
 Orc Berserker: Base HP - 10%
 Swift Phantom: Base HP - 10%
 Crusher Bot: Base HP - 6%

Towers

 Scorch Tower: Range increased (3.5 → 4)
 Arcane Missile Tower: Speed decreased (1 → 0.8)
 Magic Arrow Tower: Damage increased (8 → 10)

Relics

 Cryo Conductor: Extra Charge effect increased to +200% (was +100%)
 Unstable Mixture: The Charge effect needed to proc the relic decreased to 30% (was 50%)
 Sacrificial Pact: Now heals 1 HP for each 5 Ember Stones consumed (was 10 Ember Stones)

Buff Card

 Powerful Shot: Now increases damage by 150% (was 100%), duration lowered to 20 seconds (was 30).

notes.title: Game Update! (v0.4.1)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44393347/ebbc7138bd390dff1fab3e0b4178e2c6de82f8b0.png
New Update!

Since I was a student, I loved seeing all the weird and fun events games would hold on April Fools' Day. Now that I have my own game, it feels like I have to add something special on this day! This update introduces a few more new towers, a limited-time April Fools' character, and a mode that randomly mixes maps from four different regions.

As it's an April Fools' event, the new character is designed...differently compared to others. It might feel a bit luck-based or unbalanced, but...it's April Fools'! It’s the perfect time to add something that wouldn't normally make it into the game. (If you've been in the Discord for over a year, you might have already guessed what it is :P)

The current plan is to remove this character in the next update (around early to mid-May), or to leave it in the game and flag it as a special event character if people really like it (Since it's not decided yet, the game will show that the character will be removed in the next update). So...leave a comment after trying it and let me know what you think! I'm really curious to hear what people think about special events like this.

In the next update, I’m planning to start working on the extra difficulty mode (...ascension?). The current idea is to have different options before starting a game, allowing players to decide how much additional challenge they want to take on. Since I'll need a lot of player feedback for balancing this mode, the plan is to make and release a part of it first, then complete it over two or three updates. Also, there will be more poison towers added to balance the number of towers across each element.

That’s it for now, enjoy the update and happy April Fools' Day!

- Refi

[hr][/hr]
New Features
 New Character: JOKER
　  (April Fools' Limited - Will be removed in the next update!)

 A clown from another dimension. In his world, blocks are precious resources!
 Unlocks after completing Sealed Citadel in any difficulty

 Chaos Realm: (Experimental Feature)

 Unlocks after completing Sealed Citadel
 In this mode, each battle will randomly choose a map from one of the four regions.

Some players have suggested a marathon mode that combines all four regions in one run, but after trying it, balancing turned out to be a massive problem (basically requiring two separate settings for all the RNG), and a single run would become wayyyyyy too long (...I got tired halfway through Frost Ruins and started questioning my life when I beat the Skeleton King). So I’m trying this version first to see how it goes!

 New Towers:

 Torch Tower (1x1): Rapidly fires torches with a chance to bounce upon hitting targets.
 Icespike Tower (2x2): Launches massive, sharp spikes.
 Frost Ray Tower (1x2): Fires a freezing beam that damages enemies in a straight line.
 Scorch Tower (3x3+): Shoots flames in four directions and spins. You can freely control its rotation direction.
 Scythe Tower (2x3): The first L-shaped tower!
 Froststorm Tower (3x3): Summons a powerful freezing tornado on the battlefield!


Gameplay Adjustments:

 Chill Effect: Now applies a stackable effect. Each stack slows enemies by 5% over 2.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 7 stacks.
 Tower's upgrade options are now visible in the tooltip.
 Demon Flame:

 Towers will no longer be destroyed when the player takes damage.
 The experience gained from killing monsters and the fire level loss from taking damage now match the monster's attack power.
 (In short, killing a large monster grants +5 exp points, but getting hit by one reduces 5 levels.)

 Quest rewards that provide damage-type relics will now prioritize the elements of the towers the player is using.
 Misty Forest, Bone Desert, and Frost Ruins each have one new map added.
 The translation system has been overhauled in preparation for additional languages! 
 Character selection UI has been improved. Character abilities are now easier to read.
 Performance optimization for damage numbers.


Balance Adjustments:

 Icicle Tower: Fire rate reduced (6→5)
I didn’t have enough time to rework the Icicle Tower in this update, but the plan is to adjust its ability to better fit the ice element theme. The bonus damage effect against low-health enemies will be moved to a new tower in a future update.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where holding Shift while placing free tower cards allowed continuous placement.
 Fixed a bug where shops sometimes do not display correctly while using Candle Flame.
 Fixed an issue where the relic option and cost would change when re-entering an altar.
 Fixed an error where the Lava Tower creates lava upon placement when using Ancient Flame.


Post-Patch Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where the yellow range indicator on the Scythe Tower displayed incorrectly when its range was increased.
 Fixed a bug where the buff card "Unfreeze" could appear in non-Frost Ruins stages within the Chaos Realm.
 Fixed an issue where using the Magic Arrow Tower to enhance the Scythe Tower incorrectly boosted its attack speed too much.
 Fixed incorrect text order in the reward display on the map screen.
 Fixed a bug where the freezing effect in Frost Ruins was not activating.
 Fixed missing chill effect descriptions for the Icespike Tower and Froststorm Tower.
 Fixed pathfinding settings in certain stages.
---
 Fixed a bug that caused the path to display incorrectly when placing blocks.
 Added a feature to transfer demo version data to the full version.

notes.title: Game Update! (v0.4.0 - Sealed Citadel)
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/LfpQ1dt.gif

UPDATE TIME!!

This is the patch that took the longest time to develop since the early access launched. The past two months have truly been...a development nightmare. But now, it's finally ready! (And I can go back to making more towers!)

As usual, the fourth area comes with unique new mechanics, a new Boss fight, and new unlockable flames. Since it’s currently the last planned area, the design focus this time has returned to what really matters in tower defense games: resource management. Figuring out how to make the most of your gold, blocks, and towers, while fending off attacks and achieving other objectives, will be the key to conquering the new maps!

For the next few updates, I’ll be adding more towers and relics, as well as finishing up the remaining characters. Originally, I planned to work on the highest difficulty mode next, but I’d like to see how everyone feels about the difficulty of the fourth area first. So that might get pushed back a bit while I focus on adding other features first.

Anyway, I hope you all enjoy the new map!
If you have any suggestions, found any bugs, or think it’s too easy or too hard, please leave a comment below and let me know.

- Refi

[hr][/hr]
New Features

 New Area: Sealed Citadel
 New Flame: Ancient Flame (Unlocked after clearing Sealed Citadel on Normal difficulty or above)
 New Flame: Candle Flame (Unlocked after clearing Sealed Citadel on Heroic difficulty)

Game Adjustments

 The relic options at the Academy will not have relics with elemental effects that does not match any of the available towers.
(For example, if none of the available towers are Poison type, then there won't be any Poison-related relic in the starting options.)
 On the map, the possible positions where Workshop tiles can appear have been adjusted slightly further back.
 Slightly lowered the unlock requirements for some characters.

notes.title: Dev Chat: 4th Region Preview
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

As mentioned last time, I’m currently working on the 4th region. The development has been quite smooth (except I scrapped a main mechanic that took me 2 weeks to make and start over...), but it feels weird not posting anything for this long. So here’s a quick dev update to show what you can expect in the next patch!

The next patch will introduce the 4th region, which includes several new mechanics, enemies, a boss fight, and a new flame you’ll unlock after clearing it. Right now, I’m aiming to finish it by the end of February. But since the new mechanic is a bit more complex this time, I’ll release it on the beta branch for a few days first to test things out. If everything goes smoothly, I’ll roll out the official update!

As for the new mechanics in the 4th region...
(If you don’t want spoilers, you might want to stop reading here!)

























(Honestly, I think it’s more fun to go in blind, but if you really want to know...)

























https://i.imgur.com/nOtl8gP.gif

After passing through the gate guarded by the Skeleton King, you’ll enter an abandoned ancient city.

This was once a flourishing underground city, filled with technological wonders and countless robots that supported the lives of its residents. But when the corruption spread, it was sealed away, leaving its ancient machines abandoned in the darkness.




https://i.imgur.com/pTtiT4J.gif

Throughout the adventure, you’ll come across various mechanical devices and structures left behind, but most of them won’t work due to a lack of power.

That’s where your blocks come in!

By using blocks to connect power to these devices, you can gain more resources or unlock defensive advantages. Will you prioritize building the maze, or use blocks to activate more devices? Or maybe you can figure out a way to do both?

The new levels gives you a lot more freedom to get creative with your strategies. (Which is why designing it took forever... My brain hurts. 🫠)





https://i.imgur.com/sn7Gaw2.gif

The ancient city is also filled with defensive turrets.

Even though they’ve been dormant for years, they’ll still attempt to reactivate when you get too close, interfering with your turrets.

You can destroy them before they turn on or try to stay out of their attack range.

Or…there might be certain devices in the stage that can deal with them for you!?





Overall, aside from the tower defense aspect, the 4th region features plenty of puzzle-like elements that require more careful planning.

I’ll do my best to finish the remaining stages and boss fight as soon as possible. Thanks for your patience and support, I really appreciate it!


- Refi

notes.title: Game Update! (v0.3.5)
notes.content:
New update!!

As mentioned last time, this update is focused on revisiting older features and includes some suggestions from the community. When I started making Emberward, most of the relics and characters were designed with simpler abilities, which made them feel much weaker compared to the newer additions. This patch focuses on reworking characters and maps. I've listed the changes below and explained why they are changed!

After this update, I plan to start working on the fourth area (…😱). Since a full new area involves designing monsters abilities, mechanics, maps, and the final boss level, it'll take significantly more time than regular updates. Plus, with real-life events like the holidays and Lunar New Year coming up, I guess the next update might take until mid to late February. I know some players get anxious when they don't see updates in Early Access games, so I just want to let you know this is my full-time job now, and I'm not going to abandon it :P

By the way, the planned upcoming updates are:
- The 4th area
- The highest difficulty & enhanced boss levels
- Several small patches to add new towers, relics, and characters
- Endless mode and other game modes
- Achievements and additional languages
- Controller support
- 1.0


- Refi

[hr][/hr]
New Additions:

New Relics:
Gambler's License: If you complete a stage without taking any monster damage, gain 2 additional Gambler's Tokens.
Blessed Chisel: When you place wall blocks, they are no longer restricted by obstacles. Any tiles overlapping obstacles will be automatically cleared.
Beacon of the Sapling Queen: The detection range of your Drone Towers increase by 50%. Each Drone Tower on the field increases attack speed of all Drone Towers by 2%, up to a maximum of 50%.

Game Adjustments:

Characters:
Chunk the Builder
A common complaint about Chunk was that his mega blocks were often difficult to use or place. So...since he's a master architect, what if he's not just skilled at building large blocks, but also great at chipping them into shapes that fit perfectly anywhere!?

https://i.imgur.com/mg3HMPF.gif

Now, Boulder has a new exclusive relic: Blessed Chisel. With this, blocks can overlap with obstacles, clearing them automatically during placement. Additionally, the Mega Rune has been enhanced: it's no longer affected by corrupted blocks and now creates four buff tiles if there are other runes on the block. (but the four buff tiles are separated for balance reasons.)


Belloc the Pyroguard
Comparing to other characters, Belloc didn't receive much feedback. I think the reason is that as one of the earliest-designed characters, he lacked defining traits beyond armor. To highlight his status as a royal knight, he has gained the reworked relic "Royal Command", which gives him quest challenges for every stage. Also, he has a new ability "Royal Barrier" which helps protect your critical towers.


Royal Barrier: The tower gains a 50% damage boost and becomes immune to malfunction effects.
When monsters attempt to apply a malfunction effect, it is reflected, stunning the monster for twice the duration. This effect can trigger once every 5 seconds (ineffective against bosses).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44393347/0083e5965d267fe081bd22639976316a0916e1f5.png


Flames:
Demon Flame
Demon Flame's levels now persist across stages! The experience required increases with level.
Taking damage from monsters not only destroys 3 of your towers, but also reduces the flame level by 1.

This change was highly requested by players. Honestly, since everyone plays the game differently, balancing it is EXTREMELY difficult, and it creates a lot more restrictions on level design and monster design. But...I'm just giving it a shot. It might be changed again if it doesn't work out!


Talent Page:
Some players told me they prefer to play without talents but want full talents when playing endless mode. So, we now have a "Learn All" button! This button appears when you have enough XP to unlock all talents.

https://i.imgur.com/Yyt4R5f.gif



Map

Regarding the map, the most common feedback includes:

"I wish there were more types of nodes on the map."
"The Barracks doesn't feel like it's worth it."
"There isn't anything I want in the altar!"
"Would be better if the path choices mattered more"

This update focuses on making path selection more interesting and adjusting some of the nodes.


Battle Nodes:
In addition to rewards like towers, blocks, and relics, battle nodes may now contain three extra rewards:

 Mini Shops: Appear after completing a stage and offer some items that would (possibly) suit your build.
 Quests: Barracks challenges are now selected at the start of the level, and grant bonus rewards upon completion.
 Gambler's Tokens: Earn extra Gambler's Tokens upon clearing the level.


Also, two new nodes were added:

Anomaly Levels:
In each anomaly level, there is a special effect that makes the battle more difficult. The effects are visible on the map, so you'll need to decide whether to take on the challenge based on your build.  Similar to corrupted battles, completing these nodes grants higher rewards. 

(Let me know what you think after trying the anomaly levels! Are they too easy or too difficult? Are they fun to play? I’d love to hear your thoughts to decide whether I should expand on this or not!)

To avoid confusing new players, anomaly levels are unlocked after clearing Frost Ruins on any difficulty.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44393347/ecadfec452e8af0a32622e053246fe712fa63f06.png


Workshop:

If you played the first demo, you might recognize this node! But everything inside has been reworked from scratch. (Remember when the buff cards were in your deck!?)

In the Workshop, you can customize and enhance your blocks with three options:

- Reforge: Change a block's shape.
- Dismantle: Remove cards from your backpack.
- Enhance: Add runes to your blocks.

There are no limits to these actions. You can reshape all your block cards into LINE PIECE if you've got enough Ember Stones!

https://i.imgur.com/JWez1ml.gif


Altar:
The new version of Altar...I wasn't really satisfied with the results after some testing. Therefore, it has been reverted to the original version (for now). Since the block removing feature has been moved to the workshop, the altar's "Purify" effect has been temporarily changed to "restore all HP".

Additionally, like the shop, both the workshop and altar can now be re-entered after leaving.


Reroll:
In previous versions, reroll chances were granted 1-3 times per tower selection based on talents. Now, reroll chances are shared across the entire game, with each reroll consuming a new item: "Gambler's Token". The Gambler's Tokens can be obtained through stage rewards, mini shops, or relic effects. 

(And you can now reroll when selecting relics!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44393347/7209a16e94993ca9967a5663b364e53b5c2b9ed8.png

Towers:
Scrap Tank Tower:
The main issue with the Scrap Tank Tower is that balancing breaks when players invest all their resources into it. It's cool when you're doing it the first time, but after that, it makes the game boring.

Now, there's a 300 gold cap on the total value of towers you can feed into each scrap tank, and you can upgrade it to 500 if you want to. So building a really powerful tank is still possible, but it costs a bit more, and you can no longer dump all your resources on a single tank tower.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44393347/f20f25b8647ab443850973accd597a95228b6881.png

Dice Tower / Giant Dice Tower:
Added a button for quick reroll, with the reroll cost equal to the price of selling (based on its previous roll) and rebuilding the tower.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44393347/2b456efa70ce5b036a7f09af8b4db2332daff7de.png

Other changes

The brightness of ice blocks and the ground in ice stages has been reduced.
Tower loadout is now locked in a level to prevent issues with future modes.
Tana's tower cost increase reduced from 60% to 50%.
Scorpion King's HP reduced by ~7%, and its effects were adjusted:
  - Takes half damage above 70% HP, and moves 20% faster below 70% HP.
Relic "Energy Storage System": Towers not attacking for more than (5 -> 3) seconds will 100% critical hit on the next attack.
Monster armor damage reduction now guarantees at least 1 damage after calculation.
Fixed missing control prompts for placing block cards.


[hr][/hr]
Small patches after 0.3.5:
Fixed a display issue for Japanese fonts in anomaly levels.

New update!!

This update introduces another new character, new towers, and lots of changes! The three new towers...were much more complex to make than the others, but I really like how they turned out. (especially the tank :P) Try them out and let me know what you think!

New update!!

As mentioned before, this update adds arcane towers and relics, along with a new character! However, this character is quite different from the others. Since the early access launch, there have been many requests for a faster-paced mode. However, I understand that it might not suit everyone, so the Chrono Traveler is here to offer more exciting and dynamic gameplay, while not affecting those who prefer a relaxed experience or wish to play without a timer. So, don't worry if the new character's playstyle isn't for you! There are (at least) 4 more coming in the future.

Recently, I’ve been working on and testing the endless mode. After some testing, I feel simply extending the waves and making monsters stronger becomes boring quickly, so I plan to add some new mechanics. I’ll release it once I have a more satisfying version.

For the next patch, the plan is to add more content for other elements to balance the number of towers and relics. Also, there're some other new game modes I've been experimenting on. I'll be spending more time on them and I hope I can show them to you as soon as possible!

-Refi

[hr][/hr]
New Features

 New Character - Chrono Traveler: For players who want more challenges! Tests your speed in building mazes and your ability to control the battlefield using skills.

 (Unlock requirement: Clear Misty Forest in Hard Mode)
 The mechanics of this character involve game time and speed, so it's only available when the "Turn off timer" option is not selected!

 New Towers!

 Magic Arrow Tower (1x1): Fires arrows made of magic, dealing damage to monsters or enhancing your towers.
 Lava Tower (2x2): Pours lava onto the ground in front of it!
 Mine Tower (3x3): Places mines along the monster path around it.
 Starfall Tower (3x3): Meteor shower!!

 New Relics:

 Rusty Telescope: When your tower has no adjacent towers, its attack range is increased by 20%.
 Scepter of the Elements: When arcane damage crits, the target monster randomly receives Burn, Freeze, Poison, or Charge effects.
 Magic Dust: Monsters hit by arcane towers receive additional 20% arcane damage on their next hit.
 Ring of Shattered Ice: When arcane damage hits a frozen monster, it deals an additional 30% damage, distributed among monsters within 3 tiles.
 Forbidden Grimoire: Your arcane damage will no longer critically hit enemies above 80% health but will always critically hit those below 40%.
 Unstable Mixture: When a monster has Burn, Freeze, and more than 50% Charge simultaneously, it consumes all effects and deals arcane damage equal to 15% of its max health (3% for bosses).
 Demonic Pact: At the start of each battle, lose 1 current and maximum health but gain 50 starting gold. This effect does not trigger if you don't have enough health to pay.

Game Adjustments

 Removed the "Unlimited" option in FPS settings; the maximum setting is now 240 to prevent overheating caused by maximum GPU usage.

 Added an option to hide damage numbers.
 The relic "Chaos Transmuter" now avoids transforming towers into Drill Towers (or any utility towers added in the future).

Balance Adjustments

 Tiny: Card drawing cost is doubled.

Although many have suggested removing the elemental runes, honestly…stacking buff tiles to make an OP 3x3 is really satisfying and I want to avoid ruining it. Therefore, the adjustment this time focuses on card drawing costs. With increased costs, players will have slightly less cards each round, and need to consider whether to use cards for extending the maze or for build stronger tower. 
 Lasso Tower: The blue upgrade's stun effect now requires the lasso to remain on the target for over 2 seconds to trigger.
 Laser Tower: 

 Attack speed reduced by 20%.
 Red upgrade: Damage +2/Range +1 -> Damage +1/Range +1.

 Boulder Tower: Attack speed +20%.
 Chomp Tower: Attack damage increased from 30 to 35.

Bug Fixes

notes.title: Demo update! (v0.1.7)
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/787nWDE.gif

Hi everyone! It's been a while since the last update.

Following the Steam Next Fest, I received tons of feedback and suggestions, so I've been busy tweaking the game and have added many new features. This update includes a massive amount of content, so please try it out even if you've played the demo before! (and let me know what you think about these changes!)

Also, this will be the last major update to the demo before the Early Access launch. I'm working super hard to finish all the new features, and I'll share more news when it's ready for the launch!


New Features

New Tower: Lightning Ball Tower - Shoots lightning ball in a straight line. 
(This is a new type of tower so I’d love to get more feedback on it!)
Path Preview: You can now see changes to paths immediately while building blocks.
Block Runes: After acquiring a new block, you can enhance it with runes that offer various abilities.
Treasure Chests: Monsters will randomly drop treasure chests in battles, which you can open to choose from getting coins, healing, or various buff cards!
Skill Button: The "Overcharge” ability has been changed to a special button instead of providing an buff card every turn.
Faster Game Speed: There are now four speed settings (Slow/Normal/Fast/Ultra Fast), corresponding to the Z, X, C, V keys on the keyboard. (I know 1, 2, 3, 4 would be easier to press, but those are already used for the tower buttons.)
Tower Statistics: By clicking on a tower in-game, you can view the total damage and kill count it has achieved.
Photo Mode(?): At the end of a level, clicking the "View Map" button will temporarily hide the UI, allowing you to take photos of your completed mazes.
Talent Page Rework: Most damage-related talents have been removed, and some talents now have multiple levels.
    - Note: Due to these talent adjustments, all talents will be reset and all experience points refunded after the update.
Added game accessibility/customization options:
     - Remove countdown timer: Once activated, there will be no countdown timers in the levels, nor will time-related items appear.
     - Black fog: When enabled, the fog at the map edges will be set to black.
     - Reduce flashing effects: This can reduce the flickering effects of monsters and some special effects. (Honestly, I'm not sure what's the intensity threshold for people to start feeling unconfortable.   If you still experience uncomfortable flashing effects in the game after enabling this, please fill out a report to let me know!)
     - Block recall button: Allows changing the block recall button to “right mouse click”


Gameplay Improvements

Maps:
    - Slightly reduced the complexity of map paths.
    - Adjusted the rewards for regular levels, some of which now include "Tower + Artifact"
    - A tooltip appears when the mouse hovers over a special map cell, informing players of its function.
    Academy:
        - Now ensures that the same tower combinations do not appear.
        - Allows you to preview artifact options when selecting tower.
    Shop:
        - Added more items for sale and a reroll function, plus new talents that can apply discounts to shop items.
        - Added healing items for sale.
        - When you leave the shop on the map page, you can return to it as long as you haven't moved on to the next location.
    Barracks:
        - "Do not use ___ tower" type missions will now fail only if the tower is still present on the field during battle, or if it’s built during the battle.
        (So you don’t fail the quest if you accidently build it, as long as it’s not in battle.)
    Altar:
        - The STRENGTHEN option now also restores 5 health points in addition to increasing the maximum health.
Gameplay:
    - Now you can see what monsters are coming in the next wave.
    - Clicking on a monster in the field will display its health and attack power.
    - Elite monsters reaching the fire source will now deal 5 damage.
    - Hold mouse button to recall blocks is now faster, and you can now switch to using the right mouse button to recall instantly in the game options.
    - Added new indication for the Drone tower detection range.
    - Added a new menu for changing tower’s default priorities.
    - Pressing spacebar in battle will now switch game speed between current speed and slowest speed.
    - Redesigned poison damage. Now the tick damage increases with each attack, and deals full damage much faster.
    - Changed the visual effects for corrupted monsters.
Sound Effects:
    - Now the default volume for the game is 50%
    - Adjusted the sound effects of the snowball tower.



Balance Adjustments

Flame Tower: The flame tower will now continuously attack passing enemies without cooldown. The damage is lowered to maintain the same damage output.
Chaos Transmuter: After transformation, the sell price of towers is slightly lower.
Giant Dice Tower sell price adjustment: Lowered sell price for lower rolls.
Snowball Tower: attack range slightly reduced.


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where minecart animations in boss levels were not moving smoothly.
Corrected the Japanese translation of the "Time-Saving Device."
Fixed a problem that prevent player to build wall block near some wooden fences.
Resolved issues where some towers could not be built using keyboard shortcuts.
Fixed a problem where some sounds would disappear when there were too many simultaneous sound effects.
Corrected an issue where the wrong numbers were displayed on the Giant Dice Tower when affected by the Chaos Transmuter.

notes.title: Dev update: incoming balance patch

Hi all!

I've been working on the game's balance for a few days, and now I think I can share some details with you!

From the feedback, most of the players have told me the game is too easy right now (and I totally agree), especially with those OP 2x2 towers. However, there are also players, less familiar with TD games, told me they're happy to see a casual, relaxing TD game.


So here's what's coming:


I'm currently doing a complete rebalance, including monsters, towers, gold income, and all the levels.
Monsters will spawn less crowded, making AOE towers less effective.
There will be a mode selection screen. You can choose to play casually and crush the monsters or play on a higher difficulty.


Most of the adjustments are done, but it takes even more time to test all the levels, so please bear with me for a few more days. Thank you for all your feedback and support! It really means A LOT for a solo dev.
